name: Bewitching Mantle
body:
Price 4,500 gp; Aura moderate enchantment; CL 7; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This half length cloak of fine silk is adorned with embroidered swirling patterns. The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Bluff checks made to tell lies and a +1 bonus to caster level when casting enchantment (charm) spells.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 2,250 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, charm monster
